values.promise: Study with ten European universities without leaving home.
values.proof: Virtual and hybrid mobility, joint degrees, micro-credentials and digital wellbeing.

values.promise: Teach and research in a European open network.
values.proof: Joint programmes, Living Labs, open science and digital capacity building.

values.promise: Be part of building one European university.
values.proof: Digital transformation toolkits, equality training and the community campus.

values.promise: A pan-European reference in digital, open and inclusive education.
values.proof: Think and Do Tank recommendations and evidence from 10 universities and +368,000 students.

values.promise: Skills that match the labour market, for life.
values.proof: Professional GPS, lifelong learning and micro-credentials.

values.promise: Knowledge that is open to everyone.

axisMessages.headline: Learning without borders, powered by responsible AI
axisMessages.body: OpenEU shows how open universities use digital tools and AI to widen access and improve quality, with the Digital Transformation Toolkit and the Think and Do Tank turning practice into policy.

axisMessages.headline: Open science for a planet in emergency
axisMessages.body: Living Labs and open research bring universities, citizens and business together on climate solutions, with results shared openly across ten countries.

axisMessages.headline: Ready to debate our Europe?
axisMessages.body: Through Decidim and the community campus, OpenEU students and staff take part in decisions and debate the future of Europe, online and across languages.

voice.v: Institutional but warm, first-person plural: "we", "our alliance".
Questions or promises of 3 to 8 words. Sentence case.
Short imperatives ending in "!": Apply now! Register now! Subscribe now!
Medium weight inside light text. No italics, no underlines, no emoji.
Comma thousands with "+" for totals: +368,000 students.

tlSteps.t: Check if it is worth communicating
tlSteps.d: A result, a deliverable, a call, an event or a milestone that matters to someone outside your team.
A if your university leads it locally, B if it involves the whole alliance, C if it is part of a WP8 task.

tlSteps.t: Fill in the Communication Request Form
tlSteps.d: As early as you can. Your Communication Officer confirms the timeline and channels.
Two-line key message, facts and figures, contact person, links, and images with usage rights.
Emblem, "Co-funded by the European Union", OpenEU logo and, where required, the disclaimer.
Reach, participants, media appearances and multimedia produced, so they count toward the KPIs.

cmSteps.d: Confirm option A, B or C and who owns the action.
Work packages, audiences, channels, narrative and KPIs. Use the brief generated by the form.
Local language and channels following the Multilingualism Toolkit (D6.5) and the Communication and Dissemination Toolkit (D8.2).
Newsletter subscription, OpenEU social channels and Decidim.
No publication without the EU visibility elements.
Followers, portal traffic, media appearances, multimedia pieces and campaigns.
Send highlights for alliance-wide amplification and the central newsletter.

tlDo.text: Think about who needs to know, not only what happened
Mention the work package and the axis

tlDont.text: Publishing on your own without the EU visibility elements

cmDo.text: Use the five-block brief for every action
